class.name: NetwMultiplayer
class.brief_description: The [MultiplayerAPI] implementation for a Networked session.
class.description: Use [method Netw.of] to get it for a node. Its methods take the [RID] of an object such as a [NetwEntity] or a [NetwScene], and most game code uses those objects instead. [codeblock] var api := Netw.of(self) api.entity_despawn(NetwEntity.of(self).rid) api.scene_watch(Netw.scene(self).rid, player.id) [/codeblock] Each method prefix matches the class that wraps it. - [code]scene_*[/code]: [NetwScene] - [code]interest_*[/code]: [NetwInterest] - [code]session_*[/code] and [code]stats_*[/code]: [NetwSession] - [code]clock_*[/code]: [NetwClock] - [code]predict_*[/code]: [NetwPrediction] - [code]entity_*[/code] and [code]spawn_*[/code]: [NetwEntity] - [code]table_*[/code] and [code]liveness_*[/code]: [NetwTable] - [code]schema_*[/code]: [NetwSchema] - [code]lagcomp_*[/code]: [NetwActionConfig] - [code]player_*[/code] and [code]peer_*[/code]: [NetwPlayer] - [code]display_*[/code]: [NetwDisplay] - [code]endpoint_*[/code]: [NetwConnection] - [code]transport_*[/code]: [NetwTransport] - [code]rpc_*[/code] and [code]sync_*[/code]: [NetwMemberConfig] - [code]service_*[/code]: [NetwService] - [code]database_*[/code] and [code]persist_*[/code]: [NetwDatabase] and [NetwPersistence] The [code]player_*[/code] methods take or return a player id, which the session gives each player when its join is accepted. The id stays the same across a server transfer. Another session, such as one under a second [MultiplayerViewport], gives out its own ids, so the same number names a different player there or none.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the replication state of the wrapped [SceneMultiplayer]. Players, services and entities are kept.

method.name: clock_auto_configure_offset
method.description: Measures the connection for five seconds, then sets [constant CLOCK_PARAM_DISPLAY_OFFSET] to the largest value [method clock_get_recommended_display_offset] returned. Does nothing on the server.

method.name: clock_get_monitor
method.description: Returns one clock diagnostic value.

method.name: clock_get_param
method.description: Returns the current value of one clock setting, as an [int], [float] or [bool] depending on the setting.

method.name: clock_get_physics_factor
method.description: Physics frames per tick, unrounded. 60 physics ticks per second with a [constant CLOCK_PARAM_TICKRATE] of 30 returns [code]2.0[/code].

method.name: clock_get_recommended_display_offset
method.description: The display offset this connection needs, in ticks. It is the one-way latency plus the jitter times [constant CLOCK_PARAM_JITTER_MULTIPLIER], rounded up. It is not applied. [method clock_auto_configure_offset] applies it.

method.name: clock_get_simulation_behind_count
method.description: How many frames ended with a tick still waiting while [method clock_set_gate] was on, which runs at most one tick per frame. It stays [code]0[/code] while the gate is off. A count that keeps growing means this machine is too slow to keep up with [constant CLOCK_PARAM_TICKRATE].

method.name: clock_get_tick
method.description: The current server-calibrated simulation tick.

method.name: clock_get_tick_factor
method.description: How far time has moved past the last tick, as a fraction of a tick. Use it to interpolate between ticks. [constant CLOCK_PARAM_TICK_FACTOR_OVERRIDE] replaces it with a fixed value.

method.name: clock_get_tick_phase
method.description: How far into the current tick the clock is, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: clock_is_configured
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a [NetwClockConfig] was applied. Without one the tick does not move.

method.name: clock_is_gated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while [method clock_set_gate] is on.

method.name: clock_is_simulating
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when physics may step this frame. Always [code]true[/code] unless [method clock_set_gate] is on.

method.name: clock_is_synchronized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the clock has synchronized with the server at least once.

method.name: clock_set_gate
method.description: While on, physics steps only on frames that have a tick to run, so a tick covers the same physics time on every peer. A client runs at most one tick a frame while it is on, so its tick snaps to the server's when it falls further behind than the [constant CLOCK_PARAM_MAX_TICKS_PER_FRAME] setting allows a frame to catch up. [method clock_is_simulating] tells whether this frame steps. Calls nest, so it turns off when every [code]true[/code] is matched by a [code]false[/code].

method.name: clock_set_param
method.description: Changes one clock setting. The tickrate can only be set with [method Netw.configure_clock]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the setting changed ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED param was CLOCK_PARAM_TICKRATE ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER param is unknown [/codeblock]

method.name: clock_step
method.description: Runs one physics frame of the clock with [param count] ticks in it, now. A [param count] of [code]0[/code] runs the frame's prediction and sends with no tick. [signal NetwScene.entity_entered], [signal NetwScene.entity_exited] and the callbacks of [method lagcomp_effect_watch] for its ticks run just before it returns. [method NetwClock.step] calls it.

method.name: complete_auth
method.description: Same as [method SceneMultiplayer.complete_auth], called from [member auth_callback] when the game's own check of [param id] passes. The peer connects once its join is admitted. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED] when there is no wrapped [SceneMultiplayer].

method.name: database_close
method.description: Closes [param database] once its pending operations finish. The promise resolves with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error], see [method NetwDatabase.close].

method.name: database_delete_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot] and everything stored in it. Can be called before [method database_open]. Deleting the open slot fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY]. See [method NetwDatabase.delete_slot] for the errors.

method.name: database_erase
method.description: Removes the record at [param id]. Erasing a record that is not there succeeds. See [method NetwDatabase.erase] for the errors.

method.name: database_find
method.description: The database declared as [param name], or an invalid [RID] when none is. A database declared on a node is found from the [method Node._ready] of that node's children.

method.name: database_flush
method.description: Resolves once every operation started on [param database] before this call has finished. See [method NetwDatabase.flush] for the errors.

method.name: database_get_name
method.description: The name [param database] was declared with in [method Netw.configure_database], or empty when it does not exist.

method.name: database_get_slot
method.description: The slot [param database] holds open, or empty when it is not open.

method.name: database_get_state
method.description: Whether [param database] is closed, opening, open or closing, as a [enum NetwDatabase.State].

method.name: database_is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while [param database] exists in this session.

method.name: database_list_slots
method.description: Lists every slot stored in [param database], see [method NetwDatabase.list_slots]. Can be called before [method database_open].

method.name: database_open
method.description: Opens [param slot]. Other operations fail until the promise resolves. Opening a different slot while one is open fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY]. See [method NetwDatabase.open] for the errors.

method.name: database_patch
method.description: Writes the properties in [param values] to the record at [param id] and keeps the rest. A missing record fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. See [method NetwDatabase.patch] for the errors.

method.name: database_read
method.description: Reads the record at [param id], see [method NetwDatabase.read] for the result. [param schema] is a sealed schema, such as one from [method schema_find]. A [param database] that is not open fails the promise with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED], an unsealed [param schema] with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST], and an empty [param id] with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: database_scan
method.description: Reads up to [param limit] records matching [param filter], see [method NetwDatabase.scan] for the result. Pass an empty [param cursor] to start, and the cursor of the previous page to continue.

method.name: database_submit
method.description: Applies [param operations] in order, see [method NetwWriteBatch.submit] for the result. [NetwWriteBatch] builds [param operations]. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴operation ┠╴kind String "replace" or "erase" ┠╴address Dictionary the record's address ┖╴envelope Dictionary the sealed record, replace only [/codeblock]

method.name: database_write
method.description: Replaces the whole record at [param id]. [param values] must hold every column [param schema] declares and nothing else. See [method NetwDatabase.write] for the errors.

method.name: disconnect_peer
method.description: Same as [method SceneMultiplayer.disconnect_peer]. [method NetwSession.kick] also tells the peer why.

method.name: display_get_param
method.description: Returns one display setting of [param entity], or [code]null[/code] when it has none.

method.name: display_get_tick
method.description: Returns the tick [param entity] is displayed at, or [code]-1[/code] when it is not interpolated.

method.name: display_get_track_stat
method.description: Returns the display diagnostic [param stat] of [param entity], or [code]null[/code] when unknown. Some stats describe one [param track], and the rest ignore it.

method.name: display_reset
method.description: Clears the interpolation buffer of [param entity] and snaps its visual to the current values. Call it after a teleport.

method.name: display_set_callback
method.description:
Calls [param callback] with every interpolated value of [param entity] in place of writing its node. An empty [Callable] clears it, and setting it clears [method display_set_target_item]. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.of(self).display_set_callback(NetwEntity.of(self).rid, _on_drawn)
func _on_drawn(entity: RID, track: StringName, value: Variant) -> void: marker.position = value [/codeblock]

method.name: display_set_param
method.description: Changes one display setting of [param entity]. [constant DISPLAY_PARAM_VISUAL_ROOT] takes a [NodePath]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the setting changed ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST entity is not in this session ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER param is unknown, or value is refused [/codeblock]

method.name: display_set_target_item
method.description: Draws [param entity] on a [RenderingServer] canvas item or instance [param item] in place of writing its node. An interpolated [Transform2D] goes to the canvas item and a [Transform3D] to the instance, so the entity interpolates its [code]transform[/code]. An invalid [RID] clears it, and setting it clears [method display_set_callback].

method.name: endpoint_add
method.description: Adds a server at [param address] reached through [param transport], and emits [signal NetwConnection.endpoint_added]. Adding the same pair again returns the same [RID]. Returns an invalid [RID] when [param transport] is unknown. An empty [param address] is stored as the address a join with it reaches, so an ENet row reads [code]localhost[/code] and [method endpoint_find] finds it by either spelling. [codeblock] var endpoint := api.endpoint_add( api.transport_find(&"ENetMultiplayerPeer"), "203.0.113.42:21253") [/codeblock]

method.name: endpoint_find
method.description: Returns the endpoint for [param transport] and [param address], or an invalid [RID].

method.name: endpoint_get_current
method.description: Returns the endpoint this peer is connected through, its own on a host, or an invalid [RID] before [constant NetwSession.STATE_ONLINE]. It is also invalid when the assigned peer supplies no address, or when the peer's transport was removed with [method transport_unregister] while online. It is the listed endpoint at that address when there is one, and otherwise an endpoint [method endpoint_list] does not return and [method endpoint_probe] does not probe. The flat form of [member NetwConnection.current_endpoint].

method.name: endpoint_get_param
method.description: Returns one property of [param endpoint], or [code]null[/code] when it does not exist.

method.name: endpoint_get_probe_interval
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.probe_interval].

method.name: endpoint_get_state
method.description: Returns what the last probe found for [param endpoint]. [constant ENDPOINT_STATE_STATUS] is [constant @GlobalScope.FAILED] until the first probe.

method.name: endpoint_invite
method.description: The flat form of [method NetwConnection.invite]. Returns the invited endpoint, or an invalid [RID] when [param transport] is unknown or [param address] is empty.

method.name: endpoint_is_browsing
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.browsing].

method.name: endpoint_join
method.description: The flat form of [method NetwConnection.join].

method.name: endpoint_list
method.description: Every known endpoint, the ones added with [method endpoint_add] first.

method.name: endpoint_probe
method.description: Checks whether [param endpoint] is reachable without joining it, then emits [signal NetwEndpoint.changed]. Read the result with [method endpoint_get_state].

method.name: endpoint_remove
method.description: Removes [param endpoint] and emits [signal NetwConnection.endpoint_removed].

method.name: endpoint_set_browsing
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.browsing].

method.name: endpoint_set_probe_interval
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.probe_interval].

method.name: entity_attach
method.description: Makes [param node] an entity of this session and returns its [RID], the [member NetwEntity.rid] of its [NetwEntity]. A node that already is an entity returns its [RID]. Returns an invalid [RID] when [param node] is null or belongs to another session.

method.name: entity_despawn
method.description: Despawns [param entity] on every peer. To hide it from one peer only, use [method interest_leave]. [param opts] sets options for this call. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity is despawning ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the entity does not exist [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: entity_get_control_state
method.description: Returns the [enum ControlState] of [param entity], or [constant CONTROL_STATE_SETTLED] when [param entity] is not in this session.

method.name: entity_get_controller
method.description: Returns the peer that controls [param entity], [code]1[/code] when the server does, or [code]0[/code] when [param entity] is not in this session. [member NetwEntity.controller] answers the same control as a [NetwPlayer].

method.name: entity_get_node
method.description: Returns the node of [param entity], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: entity_get_param
method.description: Returns one setting of [param entity], or [code]null[/code] when [param entity] is not in this session.

method.name: entity_get_parent
method.description: Returns the closest entity above [param entity] in the scene tree, or an invalid [RID].

method.name: entity_get_player
method.description: Returns the id of the player [param entity] represents, or [code]0[/code] when it represents none. The player is set with [member NetwEntity.player].

method.name: entity_get_recipients
method.description: Returns the peers an RPC on [param entity] is sent to, which is every connected peer except this one. Offline, it returns [code][1][/code]. Returns an empty array when [param entity] is not in this session. Use [method interest_is_visible] to ask who can see the entity.

method.name: entity_get_route
method.description: Returns the route of [param entity], the id every peer uses to address it, or [code]0[/code].

method.name: entity_get_scene
method.description: Returns the scene [param entity] is in, the closest entity at or above it that is a [NetwScene], or an invalid [RID].

method.name: entity_get_state
method.description: Returns whether [param entity] is alive on this peer. An entity with no route returns [constant ENTITY_STATE_UNKNOWN].

method.name: entity_release_control
method.description: Hands control of [param entity] to [param successor], a peer id, or [code]0[/code] for the server. Peer [code]1[/code] is the host's player, as in [method entity_set_controller]. It works as [method NetwEntity.release_control] does, and the [NetwPromise] fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param entity] is not in this session. [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: entity_reparent
method.description: Moves the node of [param entity] under [param parent] on every peer, as [method Netw.reparent] does. The [NetwPromise] fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when [param entity] is not in this session or [param parent] is null.

method.name: entity_request_control
method.description: Asks the server to make this peer the controller of [param entity] with [param hold]. It works as [method NetwEntity.claim_control] does, and the [NetwPromise] fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param entity] is not in this session. [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: entity_set_controller
method.description: Gives control of [param entity] to [param peer]. Peer [code]1[/code] is the host's player. Given before the host's player joins, the entity stays with the server until it joins, and on a dedicated server it stays with the server, which controls nothing locally. The hold resets to [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_NONE]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK control moved ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the entity is not in this session ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER peer is not a peer id ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the entity is not spawned yet ┖╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: entity_set_param
method.description: Changes one setting of [param entity]. A refused value is reported and the setting keeps its value. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the setting changed ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST entity is not in this session ┠╴ERR_LOCKED authority cannot change once the node is in the tree ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE param is ENTITY_PARAM_HOLD, or a late TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE without AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER param is unknown, or value is refused [/codeblock]

method.name: event_arm
method.description: Records every [enum Event] in [param groups] for [method event_drain] and stops recording the rest. [code]0[/code] records nothing, which is the default. Recording never changes what the session does.

method.name: event_drain
method.description: Returns and clears the rows recorded since the last call, oldest first. The session keeps the newest 4096 rows, so drain once a frame while armed. [codeblock] func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void: var rows := api.event_drain() for at in range(0, rows.size(), NetwMultiplayer.EVENT_ROW_WIDTH): if rows[at] == NetwMultiplayer.EVENT_DESPAWNED: print("despawned route ", rows[at + 3]) [/codeblock] A row is [constant EVENT_ROW_WIDTH] values, and its [enum Event] kind says what [code]a[/code] and [code]b[/code] hold. The entity is the id of its [member NetwEntity.rid], as [method RID.get_id] returns it, and the route is what [method entity_get_route] returns on every peer. [codeblock lang=text] PackedInt64Array ┖╴row ┠╴kind int an Event value ┠╴tick int the tick it happened on ┠╴entity int the entity's RID id, 0 when it concerns none ┠╴route int the entity's route, 0 when it concerns none ┠╴peer int the peer it concerns, 0 when none ┠╴verdict int an Error, OK unless the kind judges something ┖╴a, b int two values that depend on kind, 0 when unused ┠╴EVENT_STAGE_TRANSITION a the stage left, b the stage entered ┠╴EVENT_CONTROL_CHANGED a the peer before, b the peer after ┠╴EVENT_CONTROL_REQUESTED peer is the requester ┠╴EVENT_INTEREST_ENTER, ┃ EVENT_INTEREST_EXIT, ┃ EVENT_OBSERVER_ENTERED, ┃ EVENT_OBSERVER_LEFT a the layer's RID id, peer the observer ┠╴EVENT_PREDICT_CONSUME a the queue depth, b the buffer ┠╴any other kind from ┃ EVENT_EPISODE_OPEN to ┃ EVENT_RECOVERY a the prediction transition ┠╴EVENT_SYNC_ENCODE a the bytes written ┠╴EVENT_GATHER a the rows offered, b the rows sent ┠╴EVENT_APPLY a the frames applied ┠╴EVENT_TABLE_COMMIT a the rows committed ┠╴EVENT_DISPLAY_RECORD a the tick of the sample ┠╴EVENT_DISPLAY_PUMP a the display tick ┠╴EVENT_DATAGRAM_SENT a the size, b the sequence ┠╴EVENT_DATAGRAM_RECEIVED a the size, b the sequence or -1 when reliable ┠╴EVENT_DATAGRAM_MALFORMED a the size ┖╴EVENT_ACK_ADVANCED a the newest sequence acknowledged [/codeblock]

method.name: get_authenticating_peers
method.description: Same as [method SceneMultiplayer.get_authenticating_peers].

method.name: interest_get_layers
method.description: Returns every existing layer [param entity] is in. It creates no layer.

method.name: interest_is_filtered
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param entity] is in any layer. An entity in none is visible to every peer.

method.name: interest_is_visible
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when updates for [param entity] are sent to [param peer]. That is always so for the server, for the controller of [param entity] and for an entity in no layer. A client answers for itself.

method.name: interest_join
method.description: Adds [param entity] to [param layer] from the entity's side. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity will be added, or is already in the layer ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_add_entity
method.description: Adds [param entity] to [param layer], so every viewer of the layer sees it. Applies at the end of the frame. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity will be added ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist ┠╴ERR_LOCKED layer belongs to a scene ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the layer rejected the entity [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_add_viewer
method.description: Lets [param peer] see every entity in [param layer]. Applies at the end of the frame. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the peer will be added ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer does not exist ┠╴ERR_LOCKED layer belongs to a scene ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA peer is 0 [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_create
method.description: Returns the layer called [param name], creating it if needed.

method.name: interest_layer_find
method.description: Returns the layer called [param name], or an invalid [RID]. Does not create it.

method.name: interest_layer_free
method.description: Deletes [param layer] with its viewers, entities, settings and callbacks. A layer that belongs to a scene is left as it is, and an error is pushed.

method.name: interest_layer_get_entities
method.description: Returns the entities in [param layer]. On a client, only the ones it sees.

method.name: interest_layer_get_name
method.description: Returns the name [param layer] was created with.

method.name: interest_layer_get_param
method.description: Returns the value of [param param] for [param layer].

method.name: interest_layer_get_stats
method.description: Returns the visibility counters of [param layer]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴viewers int number of viewers ┠╴entities int number of entities ┠╴visible_edges int (entity, peer) pairs that can see each other ┖╴transitions_total int shows plus hides since the layer was created [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_get_viewers
method.description: Returns the peers that view [param layer].

method.name: interest_layer_has_entity
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param entity] is in [param layer].

method.name: interest_layer_has_viewer
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param peer] views [param layer].

method.name: interest_layer_remove_entity
method.description: Removes [param entity] from [param layer], so its viewers stop seeing it. Applies at the end of the frame. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity will be removed, or was not in the layer ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist ┠╴ERR_LOCKED layer belongs to a scene ┖╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_remove_viewer
method.description: Stops [param peer] from seeing [param layer]. Entities it still sees through another layer stay. The layer's [enum NetwInterestLayer.LeavePolicy] decides what happens to the rest. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the peer will be removed, or did not view the layer ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer does not exist ┠╴ERR_LOCKED layer belongs to a scene ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA peer is 0 [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_set_driver_callback
method.description: Makes [param callback] decide which entities are in [param layer]. It runs once per frame with the layer's [RID] and returns the [RID] of every entity in it. An empty [Callable] removes it. [member NetwInterestLayer.driver] is the same with objects, and setting one replaces the other. A layer that belongs to a scene takes no callback, and an error is pushed.

method.name: interest_layer_set_monitor_callback
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(visible, entity, peer_id)[/code] when an entity enters or leaves [param layer] for a peer, where [code]entity[/code] is an [RID]. [signal NetwInterestLayer.interest_entered] and [signal NetwInterestLayer.interest_exited] report the same with a [NetwEntity].

method.name: interest_layer_set_param
method.description: Changes one setting of [param layer]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the setting changed ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer is not in this session ┠╴ERR_LOCKED layer belongs to a scene ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER param is unknown, or value is not one of its constants [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_leave
method.description: Removes [param entity] from [param layer] from the entity's side. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity will be removed, or was not in the layer ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_on_enter
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(layer_id, peer_id)[/code] when a peer starts seeing [param entity] through [param layer], where [code]layer_id[/code] is the layer's name. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the callback was added ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER callback is not valid [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_on_leave
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(layer_id, peer_id)[/code] when a peer stops seeing [param entity] through [param layer], where [code]layer_id[/code] is the layer's name. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the callback was added ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER callback is not valid [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_on_leave_policy
method.description: Sets the [enum NetwInterestLayer.LeavePolicy] for [param entity] on [param layer]. [constant NetwInterestLayer.LEAVE_POLICY_CUSTOM] requires [param custom_callback], called on the server with [code](peer_id, layer_id)[/code], where [code]layer_id[/code] is the layer's name. Other policies reject a callback. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the policy was set ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER policy is unknown, or custom_callback does not match it [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_on_perception_policy

method.name: lagcomp_action_key
method.description: Returns the key of the action that calls [param method] on [param entity] for [param view_tick]. The server computes the same key for the request it receives. The key is passed to [method lagcomp_effect_arm] and [method lagcomp_effect_watch].

method.name: lagcomp_action_request
method.description: Sends [param method] with [param args] to the server, which calls it on the node at [param target], a path from the session's root node, as the world was at [param view_tick]. The server runs it when the [method NetwActionConfig.timing] of its own declaration says. The server answers under the key [method lagcomp_action_key] returns for the entity of [param target], [param view_tick] and [param method]. On a server, a host or an offline session the action runs and resolves that key before this returns, so [method lagcomp_effect_arm] and [method lagcomp_effect_watch] are called for it first. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] while the session applies its settings. [codeblock] var key := api.lagcomp_action_key(entity, tick, &"fire") api.lagcomp_effect_arm(key, revert) api.lagcomp_effect_watch(key, confirmed, denied) api.lagcomp_action_request(target, &"fire", tick, [aim]) [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: lagcomp_effect_arm
method.description: Starts a predicted effect [param key]. [param revert] runs if the server denies it or does not confirm it within [param timeout_ticks]. [code]0[/code] uses the default timeout. [param revert] runs at the same moment as the callbacks of [method lagcomp_effect_watch].

method.name: lagcomp_effect_watch
method.description: Calls [param confirmed] or [param denied] when the effect [param key] resolves. Neither takes an argument. [codeblock] api.lagcomp_effect_watch(key, func() -> void: ghost.modulate = Color.WHITE, func() -> void: ghost.queue_free()) [/codeblock] When [method lagcomp_action_deny], [method NetwRequest.deny], [method lagcomp_action_request], [method Netw.action] or an assignment of [member MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer] resolves it outside a poll and a network tick, they run as that call returns. When a host's own [method lagcomp_action_request] runs its handler at once, a [method NetwRequest.deny] inside that handler runs them as the request returns. Otherwise they run when the poll or the run of network ticks in progress ends, or at the end of the next one. Returns [code]false[/code] when the effect is not pending.

method.name: lagcomp_rewind

var bucket := api.peer_get_bucket(peer, Bucket) as Bucket [/codeblock] [param bucket_type] must create a [RefCounted]. Returns [code]null[/code] for an unknown peer. The bucket goes when the peer leaves.

method.name: peer_get_link_stats
method.description: Returns measured connection quality to [param peer], and what this peer's byte budget sends it. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴loss float share of the last 32 packets lost ┠╴rtt float round trip time, in seconds ┠╴jitter float round trip variation, in seconds ┠╴reorders int packets that arrived out of order ┠╴duplicates int packets that arrived twice ┠╴mode String "good", or "bad" while its budget is cut ┠╴budget_bits int most bits one packet to this peer may use ┠╴budget_bytes int bytes it may be sent each tick ┠╴sent_bytes int bytes charged to it since it joined ┠╴debt_bytes int bytes it was sent past its budget ┖╴deferred_rows int rows left waiting by the last tick [/codeblock] Losing packets halves [code]budget_bytes[/code] and [code]budget_bits[/code]. Each round trip without loss adds back an eighth of the configured budget, stopping an eighth short of the rate that lost packets for the next minute. While [code]debt_bytes[/code] is above zero, volatile properties wait, and retained properties and RPCs still go.

members.member: Same as [member SceneMultiplayer.auth_callback]. It runs first on each link and receives what the other peer passed to [method send_auth]. The join continues once the game calls [method complete_auth], so the [method Netw.configure_admission] handler runs after it. Set the same callback on every peer, or the join is refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED].

Seconds a peer has from connecting until a link is admitted, or [code]0[/code] for no limit. On the server it is a joining client's deadline unless [method NetwAdmissionConfig.timeout] is declared, and the server tells the client that deadline. A client uses its own value until the server first replies, and on links to other clients. A join that passes its deadline is refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT].
Same as [member SceneMultiplayer.max_sync_packet_size]. Networked also keeps its own synchronization packets under this size.
Same as [member SceneMultiplayer.refuse_new_connections]. [LocalMultiplayerPeer] ignores it. Use [method Netw.configure_admission] to decide who can join.
Same as [member SceneMultiplayer.root_path]. It starts at [code]/root[/code], the path [method SceneTree.set_multiplayer] gives a session that covers the whole tree.
